_meta.description: METACOD GLP-1 module — English locale v2. Covers all i18n keys referenced in rule_pack_v2.json (31 rules) and pharmacist_agent v2.1.

triage.yellow.hold_and_reassess: Yellow — hold GLP-1 escalation and reassess oral therapy
action.lt4_check_tsh_4w: Check TSH at 4 weeks while on PPI
action.lt4_consider_liquid_formulation: Consider switching to liquid or softgel levothyroxine (less pH-dependent)
action.lt4_enforce_4h_separation: Enforce ≥4-hour separation from multivalent cation products
patient.lt4_separate_from_ppi: Take levothyroxine fasting, 30–60 minutes before any PPI and before breakfast
patient.lt4_fasting_30min_morning: Levothyroxine in the morning on an empty stomach; nothing but water for 30–60 minutes after
patient.lt4_separate_from_minerals_4h: Calcium / iron / magnesium / aluminum products at least 4 hours after levothyroxine
admin.lt4_tablet_ph_dissolution_failure: [admin] LT4 tablet dissolution failure with elevated gastric pH
admin.lt4_cation_chelation: [admin] LT4 luminal chelation by multivalent cations
action.iron_check_ferritin_tsat_crp: Check ferritin, transferrin saturation, and CRP at 8 weeks
action.iron_consider_iv_if_poor_response: If inadequate response at 8 weeks, consider IV iron
action.iron_consider_bisglycinate: Consider ferrous bisglycinate — better tolerated, less pH-sensitive
patient.iron_with_vitamin_c: Take iron with vitamin C (100 mg) to enhance absorption
patient.iron_separate_from_calcium_dairy: Do not take iron with dairy products, coffee, tea, or calcium supplements
admin.iron_ph_failure: [admin] Failure of Fe³⁺→Fe²⁺ solubilization at elevated pH
action.oc_recommend_nonoral_or_barrier_4: Recommend a non-oral contraceptive method or barrier method for the first 4 weeks after tirzepatide start and each dose escalation (FDA labeling requirement)
patient.oc_use_backup_4w_after_start_and: Use a backup contraceptive method (condom or IUD) for the first 4 weeks after starting tirzepatide and after each dose increase
admin.glp1_oc_absorption_drop: [admin] Delayed gastric emptying → reduced oral hormone absorption
action.furosemide_consider_iv_or_switch: Consider IV furosemide or switch to torsemide / bumetanide with more predictable bioavailability
action.furosemide_assess_congestion_obje: Objective congestion assessment: weight, urine output, chest x-ray, NT-proBNP, lung ultrasound
patient.daily_weight_log: Daily weight at the same time; report >1 kg gain in 24 h or >2 kg in 3 days
admin.furosemide_gut_edema: [admin] Oral furosemide bioavailability loss in gut wall edema
action.doac_check_label_renal_dose: Check prescribing information: DOAC renal dose adjustment is mandatory at reduced eGFR
action.doac_consider_vka_if_egfr_below_3: At eGFR <30 mL/min, consider switching to warfarin with INR monitoring
patient.bleeding_signs_education: Immediately report bleeding: gums, nosebleed, blood in urine/stool, unexplained bruising
admin.doac_renal_accumulation: [admin] Renal DOAC accumulation with bleeding risk
action.cirrhosis_consider_dose_reduction: Child-Pugh B/C cirrhosis: consider dose reduction for high-first-pass drugs
action.cirrhosis_check_label_hepatic_sec: Review the hepatic impairment section of the prescribing information
patient.report_sedation_confusion_immedi: Immediately report drowsiness, confusion, or slowed reactions
admin.cirrhosis_first_pass: [admin] First-pass collapse in cirrhosis → elevated bioavailability
action.inflammation_watch_for_toxicity: Watch for toxicity of CYP-sensitive drugs during inflammation
action.inflammation_reassess_after_resol: After inflammation resolves, reassess CYP-sensitive drug doses (risk of under-dosing)
patient.report_unusual_drowsiness_or_sid: Report unusual drowsiness or new side effects
action.fq_enforce_2_to_6h_separation: Separate fluoroquinolone from cation-containing products by at least 2–6 hours
patient.fq_separate_from_minerals_4h: Do not take fluoroquinolone with calcium / iron / magnesium / aluminum — separate by at least 4 hours
action.tetra_enforce_separation: Separate tetracycline from cation-containing products and dairy
patient.tetra_separate_from_minerals_dai: Doxycycline — apart from dairy, calcium, iron, magnesium, aluminum
action.azole_consider_solution_or_iv: Consider switching to azole oral solution or IV route
action.azole_check_trough_level: Monitor azole trough level (therapeutic drug monitoring)
patient.azole_take_with_acidic_drink: Itraconazole capsules — take with an acidic beverage (e.g., cola)
admin.azole_ph_failure: [admin] Azole capsule/suspension dissolution failure at elevated pH
action.tmax_warn_delayed_onset: Warn of possible delayed onset for Tmax-sensitive drugs under GLP-1
patient.tmax_drug_may_act_later: This medication may act later than usual — due to slowed gastric emptying
admin.glp1_tmax_shift: [admin] Tmax shift from slowed gastric emptying
action.digoxin_consider_dose_reduction: At reduced eGFR, consider digoxin dose reduction
patient.digoxin_toxicity_signs_education: Digoxin toxicity signs: nausea, visual disturbances (yellow halos), arrhythmia — report immediately
action.bariatric_doac_specialist_review: Anticoagulation specialist review when bariatric surgery is <6 months
action.bariatric_doac_consider_lmwh_vka: Consider LMWH or warfarin with INR until bariatric absorption stabilizes
patient.thrombosis_signs_education: Thrombosis signs: swelling and pain in one leg, shortness of breath, chest pain — seek care immediately
action.protein_binding_consider_free_lev: In hypoalbuminemia, consider free-fraction assay if available; total level may be misleading
action.protein_binding_clinical_response: Prioritize clinical response over total drug level
admin.hypoalbuminemia_free_fraction: [admin] Elevated free fraction at low albumin
action.tki_check_label_ppi_section: Review the TKI label PPI/H2-blocker interaction section (FDA black box for most agents)
action.tki_consider_pH_independent_alter: Consider a pH-independent TKI alternative (imatinib) if clinically feasible
action.tki_h2ra_2h_after_only_if_unavoid: If acid suppression is unavoidable, switch PPI to H2-blocker and separate by ≥2 hours AFTER the TKI
patient.tki_avoid_antacids_unless_advise: Avoid antacids and reflux medications without your oncologist's approval — they reduce TKI efficacy
lab.tki_response_12w: TKI response assessment at 12 weeks (imaging or tumor marker)
admin.tki_ph_failure: [admin] pH-dependent TKI dissolution failure — 30–60% AUC loss
action.lithium_check_level_within_1w: Check lithium level within 1 week of starting/changing a loop diuretic
action.lithium_consider_dose_reduction_2: Consider proactive lithium dose reduction of 25–50% when adding a loop diuretic
action.lithium_review_diuretic_alternati: Consider alternatives to loop diuretic (amiloride has less impact on lithium)
patient.lithium_toxicity_signs_education: Lithium toxicity signs: tremor, unsteadiness, confusion, nausea, slurred speech — report immediately
patient.maintain_hydration_salt: Maintain adequate fluid and salt intake; avoid dehydration
admin.lithium_loop_toxicity: [admin] Loop diuretic volume contraction → proximal Li reabsorption → toxicity
action.antidiabetic_proactive_dose_reduc: Proactively reduce insulin/SU dose at GLP-1 start (FDA: typically -20% basal insulin, consider stopping SU)
action.antidiabetic_intensify_glucose_mo: Intensify glucose monitoring for the first 4–8 weeks of GLP-1: CGM or 4× daily SBGM
patient.hypoglycemia_signs_education: Hypoglycemia signs: trembling, sweating, hunger, confusion; always carry fast carbohydrates
patient.cgm_or_sbgm_increase_frequency: Increase glucose monitoring frequency (CGM or 4× daily) in the first weeks after starting GLP-1
action.qt_baseline_ecg: Baseline ECG with QTc before starting a combination of QT-prolonging agents
action.qt_correct_k_mg: Correct hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia (K >4.0, Mg >2.0 mg/dL) before combination
action.qt_review_alternatives: Consider alternatives to at least one of the QT-prolonging drugs
admin.qt_combo: [admin] Additive QT prolongation — torsades de pointes risk
action.cni_accelerated_trough_monitoring: Accelerated tacrolimus / cyclosporine trough monitoring — weekly during perturbation
action.cni_anticipate_dose_reduction: Anticipate 25–50% CNI dose reduction when adding a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor or during acute inflammation
patient.cni_report_tremor_confusion: Report tremor, confusion, new neurologic symptoms
admin.cni_cyp3a: [admin] CYP3A4 perturbation during inflammation/inhibition → CNI toxicity (nephro/neuro)
action.phenytoin_measure_free_level: Measure FREE phenytoin (not total only) in hypoalbuminemia
action.phenytoin_apply_sheiner_tozer_cor: Apply Sheiner-Tozer correction: corr_phenytoin = total / (0.2 × albumin + 0.1)
patient.phenytoin_ataxia_nystagmus_repor: Report ataxia, nystagmus, double vision, drowsiness
lab.phenytoin_free_2w: Free and total phenytoin at 2 weeks
admin.phenytoin_free_fraction: [admin] Elevated free phenytoin + saturable kinetics → toxicity at 'normal' total levels
action.valproate_measure_free_level: Consider measuring free valproate in hypoalbuminemia (total may underestimate)
action.valproate_clinical_response_prior: Prioritize clinical response over total level when albumin is low
patient.valproate_drowsiness_tremor_repo: Report unusual drowsiness, tremor, appetite loss
lab.valproate_free_4w: Free and total valproate at 4 weeks
admin.valproate_free_fraction: [admin] Elevated free valproate at low albumin
action.mmf_separate_from_sequestrant: Separate MMF from bile acid sequestrants / sevelamer by at least 2 hours
action.mmf_consider_mpa_AUC_monitoring: Consider MPA AUC monitoring if available — sequestrants may reduce exposure by 30–40%
patient.mmf_separate_from_phosphate_bind: Take MMF at least 2 hours before phosphate binder (sevelamer)
lab.mpa_auc_4w: Mycophenolic acid AUC at 4 weeks (if TDM available)
admin.mmf_ehc_break: [admin] Disruption of MPA enterohepatic recirculation → reduced AUC and immunosuppression
action.cyp3a_inducer_review_alternative_: Consider switching to a non-inducer (levetiracetam, lamotrigine) if clinically feasible
action.cyp3a_inducer_anticipate_dose_inc: Anticipate increasing the CYP3A substrate dose or switching to an induction-resistant analog
patient.cyp3a_inducer_warning_breakthrou: Substrate efficacy may be lost on the anticonvulsant — report thrombosis / breakthrough bleeding / breakthrough pregnancy
lab.trough_response_2w: Trough level or response marker at 2 weeks
admin.cyp3a_inducer_substrate: [admin] CYP3A4 induction → accelerated substrate clearance → subtherapeutic exposure
action.clozapine_check_level_now: Urgently check clozapine level during infection / inflammation — may double within days
action.clozapine_consider_dose_reduction: Consider temporary clozapine dose reduction of 30–50% during active inflammation; restore after resolution
patient.clozapine_sedation_drooling_repo: Report increased drowsiness, drooling, dizziness, new seizures during infection
admin.clozapine_inflammation: [admin] Cytokine-driven CYP1A2 suppression → clozapine level doubling within days
action.lamotrigine_anticipate_dose_incre: Anticipate ~50% lamotrigine dose increase when starting a combined oral contraceptive
action.lamotrigine_warn_pill_free_week_r: Warn about lamotrigine level rebound during the pill-free week — risk of overdose
patient.lamotrigine_oc_breakthrough_warn: Possible breakthrough seizures or mood instability when OC use changes — keep a diary
lab.lamotrigine_level_4w: Lamotrigine level at 4 weeks (if TDM available)
admin.lamotrigine_oc: [admin] Estrogen-induced UGT1A4 induction → accelerated lamotrigine clearance
action.bariatric_switch_to_ir_or_alterna: Switch from modified-release to immediate-release or an alternative route
action.bariatric_consider_specialist_pha: Consult a clinical pharmacist with bariatric experience
patient.bariatric_report_drug_effect_cha: Report any changes in drug effect after bariatric surgery (weaker, stronger, different)
admin.bariatric_modified_release: [admin] Altered anatomy → disrupted MR formulation release profile
action.antihypertensive_review_taper_25_: Review antihypertensive therapy: with sustained weight loss >5%, consider 25–50% dose reduction
action.antihypertensive_check_orthostati: Check orthostatic BP (lying/standing) at every visit when GLP-1 >8 weeks
patient.report_dizziness_on_standing: Report dizziness on standing — antihypertensive dose may need to be reduced
admin.glp1_antihypertensive_taper: [admin] GLP-1 weight loss → 5–10 mmHg systolic BP drop
action.psychotropic_consider_sustained_r: Consider sustained-release formulations for Tmax-sensitive psychotropics under marked gastroparesis
admin.psychotropic_tmax: [admin] Gastric emptying delay → uneven plasma profile for rapid-onset psychotropics
action.short_bowel_consider_iv_or_pH_ind: In short bowel syndrome, consider IV route or a bile-independent agent
action.short_bowel_specialist_pharmacist: Consult a clinical pharmacist with short bowel experience
patient.short_bowel_report_drug_effects: Report any changes in drug effect, especially for lipophilic medications
lab.drug_trough_2w: Drug trough at 2 weeks (if TDM available)
admin.short_bowel_bile: [admin] Reduced bile acid pool → impaired micellar solubilization of lipophilic drugs
action.bariatric_nti_intensify_monitorin: Intensify monitoring of NTI drugs for the first 12 months post-bariatric — even with normal values
action.bariatric_nti_consider_alternativ: Consider alternative route (IV, transdermal) for NTI drugs during the first 6 months
patient.bariatric_nti_unusual_effects_re: Report any unusual effects — drug behavior may shift before symptoms
lab.drug_tdm_2w: Drug-specific TDM or marker at 2 weeks
admin.bariatric_nti: [admin] Post-bariatric PK instability for NTI drugs — high intra-patient variability
forecast.glp1.hold_no_escalation: GLP-1: HOLD escalation until GI symptoms resolve
forecast.glp1.review_recent_escalation: GLP-1: REVIEW — recent escalation, gastric emptying effect is at peak
forecast.glp1.rationale.gi_intolerance: GI intolerance (nausea/vomiting/inability to keep meds or fluids down)
forecast.glp1.rationale.first_4_weeks_at: Maximal gastric emptying delay in the first 4 weeks after start and each escalation, attenuates thereafter
forecast.risk.aki_dehydration: Risk of AKI from dehydration with persistent fluid losses — review fluid balance and nephrotoxic drugs
forecast.risk.doac_accumulation_low_egfr: Risk of DOAC accumulation as eGFR drops — monitor at 8 weeks
forecast.risk.orthostatic_weight_loss: Risk of orthostatic hypotension with weight loss on antihypertensives — review dose at 8 weeks
forecast.risk.lt4_drift_ppi: Risk of TSH drift on PPI — recheck at 6 weeks
forecast.risk.cyp_substrate_toxicity_in_: Risk of CYP-substrate toxicity if inflammation persists
forecast.risk.stable_profile: Stable profile — routine follow-up at 4 weeks
adjust.doac_reduce_at_egfr_30: Reduce DOAC dose at eGFR <30 (per drug-specific label)
adjust.antihypertensive_taper_25_50: Gradually reduce antihypertensive dose by 25–50% as weight loss progresses
adjust.lt4_review_dose_weight_loss: Review levothyroxine dose — weight loss may require adjustment
adjust.antidiabetic_review_for_hypoglyce: Review antidiabetic therapy — hypoglycemia risk with GLP-1 addition
trigger.glp1_glycemic_effect: GLP-1 glucose-lowering effect on top of existing therapy
dose.amiodarone_bmi_vd_redistribution: Amiodarone: with rapid weight loss (>2%/month) consider a ~15% dose reduction — drug accumulates in adipose tissue and redistributes as fat is mobilized
dose.lithium_tbw_dependent_recheck: Lithium: any total body water change (weight loss, dehydration, diuretics) requires urgent level monitoring — Vd ≈ TBW
dose.digoxin_lean_body_mass: Digoxin: dosing is based on lean body mass — substantial weight loss requires recalculation
dose.pgx_cyp2d6_poor_metoprolol_succinat: Metoprolol + CYP2D6 poor: drug accumulation, bradycardia risk — consider 25–50% dose reduction or switch to bisoprolol / carvedilol
dose.pgx_cyp2d6_poor_fluoxetine: Fluoxetine + CYP2D6 poor: elevated fluoxetine and norfluoxetine exposure — consider dose reduction or alternative (sertraline)
dose.pgx_cyp2d6_ultra_rapid_metoprolol_s: Metoprolol + CYP2D6 ultra-rapid: possible subtherapeutic exposure — monitor HR/BP, consider bisoprolol
dose.pgx_cyp2c19_poor_voriconazole: Voriconazole + CYP2C19 poor: elevated exposure expected — reduce starting dose 25–50%, accelerated TDM at 5–7 days
dose.pgx_cyp2c19_poor_escitalopram: Escitalopram + CYP2C19 poor: elevated QT prolongation risk — reduce dose, baseline ECG, monitor QTc
dose.pgx_cyp2c19_ultra_rapid_voriconazol: Voriconazole + CYP2C19 ultra-rapid: subtherapeutic exposure expected — accelerated TDM, consider an alternative azole (isavuconazole)
dose.pgx_cyp3a5_expresser_tacrolimus: Tacrolimus + CYP3A5 expresser: increased clearance — starting dose 1.5–2× standard, TDM at 3–5 days
dose.pgx_hla_b1502_carbamazepine: Carbamazepine + HLA-B*1502 positive: CONTRAINDICATED — high risk of Stevens-Johnson syndrome / TEN. Switch to a non-cross-reactive anticonvulsant (levetiracetam, lamotrigine)
ddi.ppi_lt4_dissolution: PPI raises gastric pH → LT4 tablet dissolution failure → reduced bioavailability
ddi.ppi_tki_dissolution: PPI raises gastric pH → pH-dependent TKI dissolution failure → AUC drops 30–60%
ddi.ppi_azole_dissolution: PPI raises gastric pH → azole capsule/suspension dissolution failure
ddi.ppi_dabigatran_reduced_auc: PPI may reduce dabigatran AUC by ~12–30% — moderate clinical significance, monitor for thrombotic events
ddi.cyp3a_inducer_doac: Strong CYP3A4 inducer accelerates DOAC clearance → subtherapeutic anticoagulation → thrombosis risk
ddi.cyp3a_inducer_cni: Strong CYP3A4 inducer accelerates tacrolimus / cyclosporine clearance → rejection
ddi.cyp3a_inducer_oc: Strong CYP3A4 inducer accelerates ethinylestradiol metabolism → loss of contraceptive efficacy
ddi.cyp3a_inhibitor_cni: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitor (azole) suppresses CNI clearance → toxicity (nephro/neuro) within days
ddi.cyp_inhibitor_warfarin: Strong CYP inhibitor (fluconazole: CYP2C9) suppresses warfarin clearance → INR rise, bleeding risk
ddi.loop_lithium_toxicity: Loop diuretic → volume contraction → proximal-tubule Li reabsorption → toxicity
ddi.oc_lamotrigine_ugt: OC induces UGT1A4 → accelerated lamotrigine clearance → potential breakthrough seizures
ddi.sequestrant_mmf_ehc: Bile acid sequestrant / sevelamer disrupts MPA enterohepatic recirculation → AUC drops 30–40%
ddi.qt_additive: QT-prolonging drug combination → additive QTc prolongation → torsades de pointes risk
ddi.cation_fq_chelation: Multivalent cation forms a non-absorbable chelate with fluoroquinolone
ddi.cation_lt4_chelation: Multivalent cation forms a non-absorbable chelate with LT4 → reduced bioavailability
projection.linear_regression_disclaimer: Projection based on ≤4 historical points — interpret as orientation rather than precise prediction; confidence interval reflects statistical uncertainty of the linear model only
